root_cause.text: The function `dtv5100_i2c_msg()` does not validate the user-controlled `rlen` value against the size of the `st->data` buffer before using it in `memcpy`, leading to an out-of-bounds write.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (rlen > sizeof(st->data))` and returns an error, directly addressing the missing bounds check. The CVE description confirms that `rlen` is user-controlled and larger values can cause an out-of-bounds access.
